topic: Anxiously counting on her fingers during the body-facts round of family trivia, forgetting how many teeth an adult human typically has.
core_question: How many teeth does an adult human typically have? (secondary: Who is credited with inventing the sport of basketball?)
answer_summary: An adult human typically has 32 teeth.; after the topic shift: Correct answer is James Naismith.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; using casual slang
